title: Manage Customers search finds customers by their tier's name
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View' and 'Customers — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a name no other tier uses, named for example Fleet Platinum.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on tier B for work orders and Default for Part Sales.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, on Default for work orders and Default for Part Sales.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Click the Customers tab.
  4. Click Manage Customers.
  5. Type part of tier B's name in the search (for example platinum).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows tier A.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The Customers tab shows Manage Customers.

Step 4:

  • The Add Customers tab lists customers A and B.

Step 5:

  • Customer A, on tier B for work orders, is listed.
  • Customer B, on Default, is hidden.
